observations: Photo 0 shows a projector displaying a close-up image of a lion on a large screen. The projector is white, placed on a surface below the screen, with a visible brand name 'VIVID' on the front.
Photo 1 shows the same projector displaying a bird on a branch, with vibrant green and blue colors. The same 'VIVID' branding is visible on the projector.
Both photos show the same setup: a projector casting an image onto a screen mounted on a wall. The screen has a black border and appears to be fixed in place.
The projector has a rectangular shape with a lens in the center and a small light or indicator above the lens.
The text 'EMMATECH PROJECTORS' is watermarked on both images, suggesting a reseller or distributor brand, not the projector's manufacturer.
No model number or additional specifications are visible on the projector or screen in either photo.
